requirements.requirement: The system must extract sponsor name and sponsor type fields from ClinicalTrials.gov metadata for each trial record.
The system must classify a sponsor as 'NIH/government' when metadata indicates a U.S. federal agency (e.g., NIH, FDA, CDC).
The system must classify a sponsor as 'academic' when metadata indicates a university, hospital, or research institution.
The system must classify a sponsor as 'pharmaceutical' when metadata indicates a commercial drug or biotech company.
The system must classify a sponsor as 'unknown' when metadata is missing, ambiguous, or does not match known categories.
The system must assign a predefined base credibility weight to each sponsor category as defined in the sponsor credibility schema from EVAL-CT-M4-S1.
The system must ensure that base credibility weights are normalized within the range [0,1].
The system must produce a deterministic sponsor_type classification for identical input metadata.
The system must return both sponsor_type and base credibility score as part of the internal scoring object defined in the schema.
The system must default to 'unknown' classification and assign the lowest defined base credibility weight when sponsor metadata is missing.
The system must handle multiple sponsors by selecting the primary sponsor when explicitly identified in the metadata.
The system must fall back to the first listed sponsor when no primary sponsor is explicitly designated.
The system must not throw an unhandled exception when sponsor metadata fields are null, malformed, or missing.
The system must log a structured warning when sponsor classification falls back to 'unknown' due to ambiguous or missing data.
The system must ensure classification logic executes within existing clinical_trials_service processing flow without increasing response latency beyond acceptable thresholds defined by the service.
